name: mdx-marketplace-packs
human_line: Packs group capabilities around a job - add the job, not ten pieces.

packs.name: Forge Builder Pack
packs.job: plan, build, prove, and review everyday software work
packs.outcome: A governed build plan carries the right repo skills, proof hooks, and review shape from intake through handoff.

safe_trial.example: Draft a plan for a small Rust route and show the proof checklist.

first_use.label: Start a build with this pack

update.change: Adds Message review handoff and tighter proof suggestions.

packs.improves_forge: build suggestions, evidence captures, and review shapes land in every run

packs.name: Svelte UI Pack
packs.job: build UI in the house style and prove it with pictures
packs.outcome: UI plans carry Svelte guidance and screenshot proof from the first request.
setup_steps: Choose the repo or team scope.

safe_trial.example: Review a small Svelte component and propose the screenshot matrix.

packs.improves_forge: UI builds get component suggestions and automatic screenshot evidence

packs.name: GitHub PR Pack
packs.job: ground builds and reviews in real issues and pull requests
packs.outcome: The active issue or pull request follows the work into Forge, Twin, Pages, and Message.
setup_steps: Choose repositories the connector may read.

safe_trial.example: Shape a two-minute review from a local fixture without contacting GitHub.

update.change: Adds Pages and Message apply-and-return context.

packs.improves_forge: intake attaches the issue, review gets the two-minute shape

packs.name: Security Review Pack
packs.job: catch obvious security mistakes before human review
packs.outcome: Drafts and changes carry deterministic injection, secret, and permission checks.
requested_grants: read bounded draft or change context

safe_trial.example: Scan a synthetic prompt-injection fixture and show the findings.

packs.improves_forge: every review stage runs the deterministic security checks first

packs.name: Render Deployment Pack
packs.job: prepare services for the day deployment authority opens
packs.outcome: Forge can draft deploy configuration and name every held authority without deploying.
setup_steps: Connect Render only after provider approval.

safe_trial.example: Draft a Render service definition from a local fixture.

packs.improves_forge: ship readiness drafts the deploy plan - deploying stays closed until its authority opens

packs.name: Supabase Data Pack
packs.job: design database changes with rollback and team review
packs.outcome: Data plans carry reversible migration guidance and deterministic security review.
setup_steps: Request migration proposal access for the team.

safe_trial.example: Draft an additive migration and rollback against a synthetic schema.

packs.improves_forge: data builds propose reversible migrations and wait for team approval

packs.name: Native Office Pack
packs.job: turn trusted work into editable Word, Excel, and PowerPoint drafts
packs.outcome: Twin and Pages can create local Office outputs while unsafe Office reading stays visibly held.
setup_steps: Choose personal, team, or repo scope.
Office input reading remains unavailable until its sandbox gate opens.
requested_grants: create local Office artifacts by reference

safe_trial.example: Preview the outline of a three-slide executive readout.

packs.improves_forge: Twin can move work into local Office artifacts without treating uploaded Office parsing as live
